transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start, can you tell me what brought you in to see me?

I’m here because for months I’ve been trying to get people to understand what’s going on. My husband’s family has been quietly messing with our money and our reputation. Like, little billing errors will show up at work, or someone at church will suddenly act strange toward me, and people act like it’s nothing. But I know it ties back to them, even when other people pull up records and say they don’t see it.
Besides these beliefs about your husband's family, have you ever heard voices, sounds, or seen things that other people around you don't seem to hear or see?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or seen things like that. It’s more about what people are doing and the patterns I’m noticing.

Over these past months, have you also noticed significant changes in your mood—like feeling extremely sad, hopeless, or losing interest in things, or on the other end, feeling unusually energetic, elated, or needing much less sleep?

I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve been stressed and upset about all of this, but I haven’t had some big mood swing or anything like that. My sleep gets bothered sometimes when I’m thinking about it, but not like I’m suddenly full of energy or not needing sleep.

Thinking back over your life, would you say you've generally been a very distrustful or suspicious person since you were young, or is this level of suspicion about being targeted something new that started just in the past several months?

I wouldn’t say I’ve always been like this, no. This level of suspicion is newer—about nine months or so. It really started after the trouble with my husband’s family over money and the holiday expectations. Since then it’s been hard not to see what they’re doing.
Aside from these concerns about your husband's family, how are things going otherwise—are you still able to keep up with your job, your usual routines, and relationships with other people?

I’m mostly keeping up, yes. I still get up and go to work, and I’m able to do my billing clerk duties. At home I keep the house going, and I still garden or paint when I can.

The main problem is when I try to tell people what my in-laws are doing. That’s when things get tense or people don’t want to hear it. Otherwise, I’m functioning okay.
